boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten source-backed places where UNL students can spend time together without paying admission or making a purchase.

cards.title: Browse Sheldon’s galleries
cards.subtitle: 451 N. 12th St., Lincoln
cards.notes: Meet in the galleries, compare one artwork each, then continue outside to the museum’s outdoor sculptures at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A free art-and-conversation stop on City Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Sheldon Museum of Art lists admission as free and offers free tours of its museum and outdoor sculptures.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday; closed Mondays and listed holidays. Check the official page before going.

cards.title: Take a self-guided gallery lap
cards.subtitle: 1155 Q St., Hewit Place, City Campus
cards.notes: Use the free self-guided format to walk the galleries together, pause at a shared favorite, and trade observations.
cards.short_summary: Free exhibitions focused on the people, cultures, and environments of the Great Plains.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Plains Art Museum states that admission is free and that self-guided tours are available to all visitors.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Great Plains Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed on major holidays, university breaks, and home-football Saturdays.

cards.title: See quilts with your NCard
cards.subtitle: 1523 N. 33rd St., UNL East Campus
cards.notes: Bring your NCard, choose a gallery section to explore together, and use the exhibit labels to spark a low-key conversation.
cards.short_summary: UNL students receive free museum admission with an NCard.
cards.evidence_claim: The International Quilt Museum lists free admission for a UNL student with an NCard.
cards.access_notes: Bring a UNL NCard. Open Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sunday, Monday, and university holidays.

cards.title: Explore natural-history exhibits
cards.subtitle: 645 N. 14th St., City Campus
cards.notes: Bring your NCard, pick an exhibit floor, and give each person time to find one object worth regrouping to discuss.
cards.short_summary: A natural-history museum visit that is free for UNL NCard holders.
cards.evidence_claim: Morrill Hall lists museum admission as free for UNL NCard holders.
cards.source_title: Visit Us | Morrill Hall | Nebraska State Museum
cards.access_notes: Bring a UNL NCard. Exhibit hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m., and Sunday, noon–5 p.m.; closed Monday.

cards.title: Read and recharge in Love Library
cards.subtitle: City Campus
cards.notes: Choose a table, pull a book or magazine for in-house reading, and leave phones aside for a focused hour together.
cards.short_summary: A campus library hang with public in-house collection access.
cards.evidence_claim: University Libraries states that its collections are open to the public for in-house use, and identifies Love Library as a library location.
cards.access_notes: Use materials in-house; an NCard is required only to check out materials. Confirm building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Use the library’s free Wi-Fi
cards.subtitle: 136 S. 14th St., downtown Lincoln
cards.notes: Claim a table, connect to the free Wi-Fi, and make it a shared work sprint or a quiet catch-up between classes.
cards.short_summary: A downtown public-library stop with free Wi-Fi and public services.
cards.evidence_claim: Lincoln City Libraries lists free Wi-Fi access among its services and identifies Bennett Martin Public Library as a location.
cards.source_title: Discover Your Community Here | Lincoln City Libraries
cards.access_notes: Bennett Martin’s listed hours are Monday–Thursday 10 a.m.–8 p.m., Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m., and Sunday noon–6 p.m.

cards.title: Walk the seasonal garden paths
cards.subtitle: Antelope Park, Lincoln
cards.notes: Take a slow loop through the beds, look for the current floral theme, and use the benches for a screen-free conversation.
cards.short_summary: A public garden with a changing annual floral design.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lincoln states that Sunken Gardens admission is free and all are welcome.
cards.access_notes: Admission is free; donations are accepted. Restrooms are listed as open April–October, 9 a.m.–8 p.m.

cards.title: Observe the prairie at Pioneers Park
cards.subtitle: 3201 S. Coddington Ave., Lincoln
cards.notes: Follow the marked paths, watch quietly for wildlife, and keep the outing simple by choosing one habitat to explore together.
cards.short_summary: A city nature center for an outdoor, no-admission outing.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lincoln states that admission to Pioneers Park Nature Center is free.
cards.source_title: Nature Center Programming | City of Lincoln
cards.access_notes: Admission is free and donations are welcome. Stay on permitted routes; the city prohibits collecting natural materials and crossing fences or locked gates.

cards.title: Stroll the demonstration garden
cards.subtitle: Antelope Park, Lincoln
cards.notes: Walk the plantings side by side, point out combinations you would try at home, and pause for photos without blocking paths.
cards.short_summary: A free public garden focused on hardy shrubs, perennials, and grasses.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lincoln states that Rotary Strolling Garden admission is free and lists daily garden hours.
cards.source_title: Rotary Strolling Garden | City of Lincoln
cards.access_notes: Garden hours are listed as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily. Admission is free; donations are accepted.

cards.title: Take the memorial walking tour
cards.subtitle: 3200 Veterans Memorial Drive, Antelope Park
cards.notes: Walk the monuments and inscribed bricks at a respectful pace, then pause to read a few names and reflect together.
cards.short_summary: A free memorial garden with military monuments and a self-guided walking tour.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Lincoln’s Veterans Memorial Garden brochure states that admission is free and describes a walking tour of its monuments and inscribed bricks.
cards.source_title: Lincoln’s Veterans Memorial Garden brochure | City of Lincoln
cards.access_notes: The brochure lists garden hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily and notes that restrooms are available April–October.
